scanner_c.notes: Strict Sep 14 Toronto-morning previous-24h scan across the U.S., mainland China/Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Europe. Technology and U.S.-equity relevance were prioritized while also scanning macro, energy, M&A, policy and finance. Major claims were verified primarily with Reuters; reports that Reuters itself attributed to the Financial Times are explicitly marked as such. Ten distinct topics were retained without duplicate padding.

items.event_title: Major global banks coalesce around a September Fed rate hike after inflation surprises
items.news_summary: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, HSBC and Deutsche Bank now expect a 25 bp Fed hike at the September 15-16 meeting after stronger-than-expected inflation and oil above $100 revived inflation concerns; futures were pricing roughly a 90% chance of a hike.
items.investor_materiality: A near-term Fed hike directly changes discount rates, Treasury yields, equity multiples, dollar-sensitive assets and the relative valuation of long-duration technology stocks.
items.selection_reason: This is the highest-impact cross-asset catalyst in the window and represents a sharp reversal from earlier expectations that the Fed would stay on hold.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters synthesis citing multiple major-bank forecasts and current market pricing; high-quality macro confirmation.
items.youtube_query: Fed September 2026 rate hike inflation oil

items.event_title: AI slowdown warnings hit Nasdaq futures and pressure chip stocks
items.news_summary: Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 1.7% as public calls to slow frontier-AI development pressured AI-linked equities. Nvidia fell more than 2% premarket, while Intel, AMD and Marvell were reported down roughly 5%-6%; some software names rose as investors reconsidered the pace of AI disruption.
items.investor_materiality: This is a direct market repricing of the AI-capex and AI-disruption narrative across mega-cap technology, semiconductors and enterprise software.
items.selection_reason: It converts the recent AI-safety debate into an identifiable, same-day equity move rather than a purely philosophical story.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters real-time market report with named stock and futures moves; strong source for the immediate investor reaction.
items.youtube_query: AI slowdown Nvidia NVDA Nasdaq chip stocks
items.video_angle: AI公司自己喊慢下来，为什么先砸的是芯片股、反而有些软件股上涨？把AI资本开支和AI替代逻辑拆开讲。

items.event_title: Oil jumps above $108 after Saudi pipeline outage and new Middle East attacks
items.news_summary: Brent rose more than 3% to about $108 per barrel and WTI to roughly $103.5 after attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and ships intensified supply fears. The Saudi East-West pipeline disruption potentially affected export capacity tied to as much as 4% of global supply.
items.investor_materiality: Oil above $100 feeds directly into inflation, bond yields, Fed expectations, airline/transport costs and energy-sector earnings.
items.selection_reason: The story links a fresh physical supply disruption to the same inflation shock driving the Fed repricing, giving it broad U.S.-market relevance.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters energy-market report with contemporaneous futures prices and physical-infrastructure context.
items.youtube_query: Brent oil Saudi pipeline Hormuz September 2026
items.video_angle: 油价重新站上108美元，真正危险的不是能源股涨跌，而是它可能把美联储重新推回持续加息。

items.event_title: ASML High-NA adoption broadens as TSMC, Samsung, SK Hynix and Intel commit
items.news_summary: ASML says standard EUV tools are effectively sold out through 2027 while customers accelerate commitments to roughly $400 million High-NA systems. TSMC plans adoption from 2030, Samsung and SK Hynix from 2028, and Intel says it has processed more than one million wafers with High NA.
items.investor_materiality: High-NA adoption supports ASML's long-duration equipment moat and signals continued leading-edge capex at TSMC, Samsung, SK Hynix and Intel despite debate over AI spending durability.
items.selection_reason: One of the strongest fresh semiconductor supply-chain stories because several major chipmakers are simultaneously validating a very expensive next-generation production technology.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters enterprise reporting with direct executive commentary and adoption timelines from major chipmakers.
items.youtube_query: ASML High NA TSMC Samsung SK Hynix Intel

items.event_title: Samsung and SK Hynix reject KEPCO's $18.7 billion power prepayment proposal
items.news_summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix rejected a KEPCO proposal asking them to prepay 25 trillion won, about $18.7 billion, to support electricity supply for planned semiconductor mega-clusters.
items.investor_materiality: Power availability and financing are becoming binding constraints on semiconductor and AI-memory capacity expansion, with implications for HBM supply, capex economics and Korean chip competitiveness.
items.selection_reason: This is a concrete example of electricity infrastructure becoming a semiconductor bottleneck rather than a generic data-center power story.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report based on a document submitted to a South Korean lawmaker; strong documentary basis.
items.youtube_query: Samsung SK Hynix KEPCO power semiconductor cluster
items.video_angle: HBM下一轮扩产可能不是卡在机器，而是卡在电：韩国两大内存厂为什么拒绝先掏187亿美元电费。

items.event_title: Anthropic reportedly expects a second consecutive profitable quarter
items.news_summary: The Financial Times reported, via Reuters, that Anthropic told investors it expects positive adjusted operating income for a second consecutive quarter, with reported gross margins above 80% before partner revenue-sharing and model-training expenses.
items.investor_materiality: Anthropic profitability is relevant to the economics of frontier AI and to Amazon and Google, both major strategic partners/investors, while also informing whether AI demand can support current infrastructure spending.
items.selection_reason: The profitability signal directly counters the narrative that frontier AI remains structurally loss-making, making it especially relevant amid today's AI-capex skepticism.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report citing the Financial Times; Reuters said it had not independently verified the report, so financial details should be presented as reported rather than confirmed.
items.youtube_query: Anthropic profitable quarter Amazon Google AI margins
items.video_angle: 一边喊AI要放慢，一边Anthropic据报连续两个季度赚钱：最前沿大模型到底有没有开始证明商业模式？

items.entity: Bank for International Settlements / AI markets
items.event_title: BIS warns global AI market momentum is showing vulnerability
items.news_summary: The BIS warned that AI-driven market momentum is becoming more vulnerable as investors question long-run profitability and debt rises around major technology companies and private AI financing. It also highlighted risks from bond yields, fiscal fragility and opaque leveraged financing.
items.investor_materiality: A BIS warning matters because it connects AI valuations to credit conditions, bond yields and leverage rather than treating the sector as an isolated equity trade.
items.selection_reason: This is a high-level institutional challenge to the durability of the AI rally and complements, without duplicating, the same-day stock reaction to AI-slowdown warnings.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters coverage of a BIS report and direct BIS official comments; authoritative systemic-risk source.
items.youtube_query: BIS AI market debt vulnerability tech stocks
items.video_angle: AI泡沫真正需要担心的也许不是估值，而是债务：BIS为什么开始盯上AI融资结构。

items.event_title: Michael Dell's DFO Management reportedly leads a planned $7.7 billion Baldwin take-private
items.news_summary: The Financial Times reported that DFO Management and Sequence Holdings are in advanced talks to acquire Baldwin Insurance Group in a transaction valued around $7.7 billion, with a reported $32.50 per-share price and an announcement potentially as soon as Monday.
items.investor_materiality: A large U.S. take-private can reprice BWIN directly and provides a read-through on private-equity appetite and financing conditions while rates are rising.
items.selection_reason: It is a clearly identifiable U.S. M&A catalyst with a concrete reported valuation and near-term announcement window.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters citing a Financial Times report; Reuters could not independently verify the deal at publication, so the transaction remains reported rather than confirmed.
items.youtube_query: Baldwin BWIN Dell DFO take private 7.7 billion

items.event_title: China Gas signs 20-year U.S. LNG purchase deal with Venture Global
items.news_summary: China Gas agreed to import 0.5 million metric tons of LNG annually for 20 years from U.S.-based Venture Global starting in 2030, taking its long-term commitments with Venture Global to 2.5 million tons per year despite current Chinese tariffs on U.S. LNG.
items.investor_materiality: The agreement is a long-duration demand signal for U.S. LNG exporter Venture Global and may indicate a reopening of U.S.-China energy trade ahead of higher-level bilateral engagement.
items.selection_reason: This is a concrete cross-border contract with direct relevance to a U.S.-listed LNG producer and China trade policy.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting on a signed long-term supply agreement; high-quality identifiable corporate catalyst.
items.youtube_query: Venture Global VG China Gas LNG 20 year deal
items.video_angle: 中美能源贸易又出现新信号：在中国仍对美国LNG征税时，为什么还签20年长约？

items.event_title: China urges companies to increase FX hedging as a stronger yuan pressures exporters
items.news_summary: China's FX regulator has informally pushed banks to encourage more corporate hedging as the yuan, up about 4.3% this year and near a four-year high, creates currency losses for exporters. Corporate FX-derivative usage has risen sharply as authorities try to cushion trade-heavy regions.
items.investor_materiality: A stronger yuan affects Chinese exporter margins, global supply-chain pricing, dollar-sensitive U.S.-listed China names and companies sourcing heavily from China.
items.selection_reason: It is a fresh policy response to an unusually strong yuan and provides a China macro catalyst with direct corporate-earnings implications.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters sourced report describing guidance from China's SAFE and current hedging activity; policy detail is based on sources rather than a formal public directive.
